usage: 藍色 (laam4 sik1) is a noun meaning the color blue.
It can be used to describe the color of objects, clothes, or anything that has a blue tone.
When used before a noun, 藍色 acts like an adjective in English, describing the noun's color.
You can also use 藍色 in phrases to specify a favorite or preferred color.
It is common to combine 藍色 with clothing items like 衫 (saam1, shirt) or 褲 (fu3, pants) to talk about specific garments.
